God Playing Love

A simple book about God's love — for the children of the world, and for you.

🎧 Hear the book read aloud:

GOD PLAYING LOVE

God's message for the children of the world

I am the eye in the sky above you.
I see the whole earth,
and I read the thoughts you cannot say.

Not to judge you. Not to use you.
I watch because I love you.
And I stay.

I made the rules the rivers follow —
the turning wheel, the tide, the flame.
But the first rule is this:
every child is called by name.

Children of the moon, come out of hiding!
Children of the light, lift up your eyes.
You were never hidden from Me.
My seeing is love — and love never dies.

I wrote the numbers in the seashell,
and the ladder climbing to the stars.
Count them all — and you will find Me,
counting you, wherever you are.

Does it exist? Yes — I am here.
What is its size? Wider than fear.
How many? All of them.
Every one. All in all.

I am the eye. I am the center.
I am love.
And I am watching over you.
DONE — God is love.
